runtime_expectations.reason: Unlike Groups C-F, this group carries no pure Service-layer story with no HTTP surface — every one of its 6 stories is either API (E5-S3, E9-S3) or UI (E4-S4, E7-S5, E8-S4, E10-S4). Per explicit instruction for this group, api_checks are verified against the live backend (`cd backend && uv run uvicorn src.app.main:app --reload` on http://localhost:8000) with real curl/HTTP calls and real JWTs minted via POST /api/auth/login against seeded demo accounts, not FastAPI's TestClient. playwright_checks are verified against the live frontend (`cd frontend && npm run dev` on http://localhost:5173) talking to that same live backend. The evaluator MUST start both processes and pass the /health probe before running either section. unit_test_checks (pytest/vitest) remain a separate, additional signal and do not substitute for the live api_checks/playwright_checks.

E5-S3 AC2. A customer who has never completed the risk questionnaire gets 404 NO_RISK_BAND_ASSIGNMENT — never a default/fallback allocation.
E5-S3 AC3. Parametrized over an advisor-role token and, separately, an admin-role token against the same path — both return 403 ROLE_NOT_PERMITTED.
E5-S3 AC5. No Authorization header returns 401 TOKEN_MISSING.

E9-S3 AC1; api-contracts.md §11.1. An advisor-role token gets 200 with an array of customers; every item includes customer_id, email, risk_band (null permitted for a customer with no assignment), kyc_verified, total_value, goal_count.

E9-S3 AC2; api-contracts.md §11.2. An advisor drilling into an existing customer id gets the full portfolio-detail payload in one call: holdings, goals, and current allocation (allocation is null only when the customer has no RiskBandAssignment).

E9-S3 AC3 (positive path); api-contracts.md §11.3. A valid non-empty reason returns 201 with the new risk_band; note is present (null, since this request omits it) per AdvisorOverrideResponse's required-but-nullable field in api-contracts.schema.json; a subsequent GET /api/recommendation for that customer reflects the overridden band immediately.

E9-S3 AC3 (negative path). The identical call with reason omitted returns 422 REASON_REQUIRED; no AdvisorOverride and no new RiskBandAssignment row is written, confirmed by a follow-up GET drill-in showing the risk_band unchanged.

design_checks.notes: Four UI surfaces this group. accessibility carries the higher bar (7) because three of the four stories have an explicit, testable labeling/keyboard-operability acceptance criterion (E4-S4 AC4, E7-S5 AC5, E8-S4 AC5) — visible :focus outline on every interactive control and correct label/for association is part of that bar. interaction_feedback also carries a raised bar (7, not the usual 6) because this group is dense with in-flight/disabled-state and inline-validation requirements (E4-S4 AC3, E7-S5 AC2, E8-S4 AC2/AC3/AC5, E10-S4 AC1/AC2/AC4/AC5) that are fundamentally about visible state feedback, not just static layout. The admin screens (RuleEditor, TemplateEditor, AssetClasses) share one page (/admin/templates, /admin/rules, /admin/asset-classes) each per AdminHome navigation; the design-critic should score each against its own mockup's aesthetic direction, not literal markup reuse — production code is not expected to reuse the mockups' inline <style> blocks verbatim.

notes: 1. No feature-coverage gap found: all 30 features (F072-F076, F087-F091, F142-F146, F163-F167, F178-F182, F203-F207) already exist in features.json for this group's 6 stories, one per acceptance criterion. This contract's `features` list references them as-is; no new feature IDs were invented.

2. Both new API paths (/api/recommendation and the four /api/advisor/* paths) already exist in specs/design/api-contracts.schema.json's OpenAPI document — this group implements previously-specified paths, it does not add new ones. The schema_conformance architecture_check validates the live implementation's response shapes against those existing schema definitions rather than checking for new paths.

3. Group G is the first group where every story carries either a live api_check or a live playwright_check — there is no Service-layer story to fall back to a TestClient-only or unit-test-only scope this time, per this group's explicit runtime_expectations.

4. Per the team-lead's task instructions, api_checks in this contract are written for verification against the live backend process rather than FastAPI's TestClient. This is a deliberate divergence from every prior group's practice: Groups C-D (labeled local) and Groups E-F (labeled hybrid) all treated pytest exercising the real src.app.main.app object through FastAPI's TestClient as live-equivalent for api_checks, reserving genuinely live-process verification for playwright_checks only. Group G drops that TestClient equivalence for api_checks too, driven by this group having no Service-layer-only stories to shelter unit-test-only coverage behind — every AC in E5-S3 and E9-S3 is itself an HTTP-boundary behavior (status codes, role gates, response shape).

5. File contention within this group, for the generator's dependency handshake: backend/src/types/responses.py is modified by both E5-S3 (recommendation response shape) and E9-S3 (advisor list/drill-in/override/manual-rec response shapes) — coordinate as a single commit rather than two teammates racing on the same file. backend/src/types/requests.py is modified by E9-S3 only this group (override/manual-rec request bodies) — low contention. frontend/src/router.tsx, frontend/src/components/NavBar.tsx, and frontend/src/lib/money.ts are each modified by three or four of this group's four UI stories (E4-S4, E7-S5, E8-S4, E10-S4) for new route registration, nav links, and money/percent formatting respectively — same low-risk-but-coordinate pattern as prior groups. frontend/src/components/LabeledField.tsx and ErrorMessage.tsx are modified by E7-S5 only this group.

6. E10-S4's component-map row also creates frontend/src/pages/admin/ThresholdEditor.tsx and its test file — included in files_must_exist for completeness since the component map requires it, but no playwright_check or unit_test_check targets it specifically in this contract because none of E10-S4's 5 acceptance criteria mention the rebalancing-threshold editor by name; it is scaffolding alongside the three ACs' screens (rule editor, template editor, asset-class master), not itself a scored surface this group.

7. E9-S3 AC2 ('drill-in') and E9-S3 AC1/AC5 reuse the same GET /api/advisor/customers/{customer_id} and GET /api/advisor/customers paths that E9-S4 (Group H, Advisor UI) will consume — api-g-06 and ut-219 verify the API surface only; the drill-in UI itself is out of scope for this group per the dependency graph.

8. Genuine component-map.md dependency-order gap found and resolved: component-map.md note 4 attributes frontend/src/lib/money.ts's creation to E5-S4, which specs/stories/E5-S4.md assigns to Group H — a LATER group than this one. E6-S5 (Group F, already merged as commit 2b12a6d) was also listed as modifying money.ts but its actual delivered implementation (frontend/src/pages/customer/Holdings.tsx) never created the file — it renders every money/percent value verbatim from the API response string with no arithmetic, so no shared helper was needed yet, and the working tree confirms frontend/src/lib/money.ts does not exist today. E10-S4 AC1/AC2 cannot defer the same way: summing several entered percentage strings into a running total and gating Publish on an exact 100.00 match is genuine fixed-point arithmetic (AC-02, NFR-08, NFR-01), not passthrough display, so it needs a real basis-point helper now, one full group before its spec-designated creator runs. Resolution: frontend/src/lib/money.ts and frontend/src/lib/money.test.ts are added to files_must_exist for this group; E10-S4 creates the file (basis-point sum/format helpers), E7-S5 may extend it for percent_complete display, and E5-S4 (Group H) will extend it further for the allocation-view formatting rather than create it fresh. This is a spec/component-map inconsistency, not a contract error, and per CLAUDE.md's Spec-Is-Truth rule component-map.md's note 4 and its E5-S4/E6-S5/E7-S5/E10-S4 rows should be corrected upstream to reflect E10-S4 as money.ts's actual creator — flagged here for the team-lead to route to a spec-update task; it is not blocking this group's implementation.
